about: Static DRAM (.dram0.bss + .dram0.data) per shipped variant, checked by check_static_dram.py on every release image. baseline: the last measured tree, the merge of the release line into main (78fd558e, 1 Nov 2026), so a report reads as growth since then. ceiling: the v4.5.15 ELF (b38e0a51) + 1024 B, unchanged by that re-base. Raising a ceiling needs the bench heap A/B (idle and request-start free heap, before and after) in the PR. Engine 2 (lane RB-I0): each *-e2 env has its own row; baseline is the engine-2 stub seam's measurement (20 Nov 2026), ceiling is the engine-1 twin's ceiling (engine 2 may never take more internal RAM than the shipped engine-1 image of the same board); the two test-console e2 images (no engine-1 row) get the product e2 ceiling plus the console's measured 2,816 B.
